dedupe_note: These findings are additional evidence for the existing full-catalog audit UUID only. No application task is created here, and already-completed application UUIDs must continue to take precedence over research-only classifications.

tools.commission: 25% recurring commission for 12 months on each referred customer
tools.payout_terms: Affiliate dashboard provided through FirstPromoter; current public page does not state a payout threshold or payout method, so those values remain unknown.
tools.eligibility: Official affiliate page lists agencies, consultants, creators, educators, software reviewers and partners with an audience interested in AI agents/support automation/business productivity as good fits.

alternate_program.commission: 30% of each client DocsBot subscription for the first year
alternate_program.cost: Free Partner workspace for approved agencies and AI consultants
alternate_program.notes: Partner path is aimed at agencies/AI consultants delivering client deployments; it is distinct from the general affiliate path and should not be conflated during application routing.

tools.evidence_summary: DocsBot's current official affiliate page confirms a free FirstPromoter program with a unique referral link, 25% recurring revenue share for 12 months and a 60-day cookie. A separate official agency/consultant Partner Program offers a free approved workspace plus 30% of client subscriptions for the first year.

tools.commission: 30% on the referred customer's first purchase plus 20% recurring commission while the referred customer keeps an active subscription
tools.payout_terms: No minimum payout threshold; official page lists PayPal and bank transfer as payout options.
tools.eligibility: Official page says no technical experience is required and explicitly welcomes content creators, influencers, marketers, agencies, developers, consultants, coaches, tech enthusiasts and educators.
tools.approval: Official FAQ says there is no approval process; sign up, receive the referral link and start promoting.
tools.evidence_summary: Getgabs' current official affiliate and partner pages confirm free signup, 30% first-purchase plus 20% recurring commission, 90-day cookie, no minimum payout threshold, and a dedicated affiliate dashboard.

tools.commission: 20% of eProfessor net profit from each referred customer, continuing for the lifetime of the active paid referral while the referrer remains enrolled and in good standing
tools.payout_terms: Commissions clear 60 days after the referral payment; withdrawals can be requested after at least $50 USD in cleared earnings. Current help documentation describes PayPal setup and W-9 for US taxpayers or W-8BEN for international users before payouts.
tools.eligibility: Age 18+ and legally allowed to participate. A paid eProfessor account is not required because the official terms allow a free Referral-Only Account.
tools.maintenance_requirement: Future commissions stop if the referrer leaves/cancels program enrollment; referred accounts must remain active and paid.
tools.evidence_summary: eProfessor's current official Referral & Ambassador terms confirm a free referral-only participation path, 20% lifetime commission on net profit, a 60-day clearing period and a $50 withdrawal threshold. International payout setup may later require W-8BEN documentation, which should be treated as a payout-stage compliance step rather than a reason to misclassify the program as unavailable.

The current official Nudgera site was checked directly, and fresh site-restricted searches for affiliate, referral, partner and commission terms returned no official program page or application path. No generic homepage/signup URL is counted as an affiliate link.

FeatureShark's current official site navigation and fresh site-restricted searches were checked for affiliate, referral, ambassador and partner monetization paths. No official affiliate/referral application page or commission program was found, so the catalog entry is classified no_program_found rather than using a generic signup or lifetime-deal page.
